verdict.rationale: The AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395 is a laptop/desktop processor (APU) with an on-device AI software stack. A sandbox-versus-production data environment is a service or platform axis that does not apply to a chip. Local or air-gapped inference via GAIA is data-privacy positioning, not a sandbox test environment, so it does not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
